Stealth (legal/fintech document automation) | Full-Stack Developer (Mid/Senior) | ONSITE (Milan, Italy) | Full-time | €30–40k RAL

We’re a startup building a document automation + workflow platform for the legal and financial sector: automated contract/act generation, data extraction, business rules, due diligence, reporting. Core is an AI-powered (LLM + OCR) workflow engine configurable via a visual editor. Cloud-first, with on-prem installs for some enterprise customers.

Role

- Work across the whole platform: UI → AI integrations → support for on-prem deployments. - Improve and maintain an existing production codebase (read/understand/refactor/ship incremental improvements).

Compensation is €30–40k RAL, depending on experience

Work mode is mostly onsite; flexibility depends on ongoing activities and team needs

Apply by emailing: app-navi8e at icloud.com (subject: “HN — Full-Stack Developer”)
